items.title: Corning (GLW) In Focus As Reported US Curbs Hit Chinese Data Center Gear
items.summary: Corning (NYSE:GLW) is in focus after reports of new US restrictions on Chinese data center equipment imports. The reported curbs could push US data center operators to source more optical components from domestic suppliers such as Corning. Industry traders are watching how any formal US rules on Chinese data center hardware might affect contract pipelines for US optical vendors.
